title: No More Tickling
can_do: 用清楚、直接的语言要求停止不喜欢的身体互动。
trigger: Dad starts playful tickling, but the child no longer enjoys it.
core_response: Please stop. I don't like that.
stretch_response: Please stop. I need some space.
repair_response: No tickling. A funny face is okay.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Here comes the silly tickle monster!

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Please stop. I don't like that.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: I stopped. Do you need some space?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Yes, please. I need space beside me.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: I will sit over here. Would a funny face be okay?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: A funny face is okay. No tickling.

replay_cards.title: Stop the loud sound
replay_cards.change: Dad repeats a sound close to the child
replay_cards.challenge: Ask him to stop, request quiet space, then choose a softer game if wanted

replay_cards.title: Do not move my hair
replay_cards.setting: Getting ready in front of a mirror
replay_cards.change: Mom playfully changes the child's hairstyle after the child objects
replay_cards.challenge: Say stop clearly, Mom stops immediately, then the child chooses whether to brush independently

parent_support: Stop the action immediately at the first clear request; discussion comes afterward.
Do not require please, eye contact, or an explanation before respecting a body boundary.
